title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.03618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models

translated_title: Strategist：基于智能体的推理策略演化
translated_abstract: 模型只是AI智能体系统的一半，另一半是推理策略：即将模型调用转化为最终响应的推理过程。如今这另一半仍需人工编写，且构建某一策略的经验无法延续到下一个策略。我们提出了Strategist，一个能够在不同任务间演化推理策略的元智能体。每个策略都被编写为蓝图——即可被其他策略复用的可执行代码，所有蓝图共同构成一个策略库。给定一个任务和一个小型开发集，Strategist会检索相关蓝图、编写候选策略、在真实样本上进行测试，并根据测试结果进行修订。每个候选策略随后都会进入策略库，使后续任务能够建立在先前发现的基础之上。在30个基准测试中，Strategist在24个上击败了最强基线，并以低39%的推理成本达到与其相当的平均准确率（74.7% vs. 74.0%）。此外，其策略还能迁移到未见过的任务和其他模型上。
tldr: Strategist是一个元智能体，通过将推理策略编写为可复用的蓝图并维护策略库，实现跨任务的推理策略自动演化，在30个基准测试上以低39%的推理成本达到与最强基线相当甚至更优的性能，且策略可迁移至未见任务和其他模型。
en_tdlr: Strategist is a meta-agent that automatically evolves inference strategies across tasks by maintaining a library of reusable blueprint code, matching or beating the strongest baseline on 30 benchmarks at 39% lower inference cost, with strategies that transfer to unseen tasks and other models.
